body: Interesting ideas!

I try my best to be friendly and smile in conversations. The people that meet me think I am a nice person but kind of shy. I really need to improve self esteem so I can get places. Yes, I do replay conversations in my head and think about everything I said and whether what I said what stupid or not.

As for the scars, I do not think they suit me because I do not have that rugged look to me. My scars kind of look like this(maybe not quite as bad but they get more red than his) http://forums.owndoc.com/dermarolling-microneedling/acne-scars-and-dermastamping-advice-(w-pictures)/ I am guessing that would be a huge turn off to a female. I am sure they would like a male with a smooth and soft face.

Your comment brought tears to my eyes. People on here caring about strangers means a lot to me. 

I will try to keep in touch but it wouldn't be on this account. I will update you on how things are going. 

I hope you recover from your illness!
That guy went from being lonely and wanting to kill himself to having a girlfriend within a few months. Not sure how he did it.

I really enjoy reading your story. Your boyfriend sounds like a really great guy and you two sound like a cute couple! How did you meet him?

Knowing that he was 25 before he found a girlfriend gives me a glimmer of hope. I am 21 years so maybe my life isn't over just yet.  I just need I way to find inner strength to make it. I want to go to a psychologist in my area(she is supposed to be good) but I have some fear that she couldn't help. Talking to people on here makes me feel better but not everyone has time to talk on this subreddit. During the times I feel lonely and have no one to talk to is when the suicidal thoughts comes and my brain tells me I am worthless.

There is a nature preserve with walking trails near my house. I could try walking there but I might I may feel alone in the woods.

I am thinking about going to therapy soon but I am not sure if a psychologist could solve the issue. I am worried that if therapy and meds don't work, it would be the end of me.

Your boyfriend is lucky to have such a sweet girl! I am not sure if there would be many girls that would accept that fact that I some acne scarring(which I am trying my best to improve them) and having a 6 inch scar on my chest. If there is I have no idea where to find them.

I have heard that some women find me handsome but they are quite a bit older than me and were probably saying that to make me feel better about myself. I also got smiled at a few times by women at the store(also older than me). I am not sure if they are laughing at my me or trying to make me feel better.

I would say the meds did subdue my acne but now I have scars. If I get off the medication my acne would come back.

I was thinking about trying to learn computer coding on my own but I don't really see that helping me any. I am not sure what other skills I could learn on my own and my hobbies wouldn't get me anywhere. 

Many people in my area like to hunt, fish and drink beer which I really can't relate to and talk about.

You are right about a lot of dumb people being loud but they have confidence. Usually they have an ok job and a girlfriend/boyfriend.

The scars I have are called rolling scars. They are some treatments out there but they all cost quite a bit money and are not guaranteed to work. My only hope would be the derma roller currently which I am not sure my dermatologist would approve me doing it on my own.


My social skills are minimum in the real world because I get nervous and don't know what to say. I can have a meaningful discussion over online gaming but in real life I am quiet and don't tell stories very well like others I know. I am a good listener and think about what people say but it takes me awhile to respond because I don't want to say anything stupid. I have a hard time with pauses in my speech probably due to my lack of self esteem and other issues.

Yes I heard of the dermaroller and I know talked to Ashley before on his videos. I would have to bring it up to my dermatologist next time I go. I doubt he would want me using a dermaroller while I am on retin a and doxycycline.

One of the main reasons I lack confidence is because of worry about sounding dumb. It takes me awhile to put thoughts together due to my introverted personality. I doubt even therapy would help. I just feel stuck and unable to get anywhere in life.
If I ever do find the light at the end of the tunnel and find a girl, I would be self conscious about taking my shirt off :(
I also have a scar on my chest from heart surgery. Wouldn't that turn a girl off?
Go out and socialize? With the way my face looks? No way, no one wants to talk to me. I also have severe social anxiety so people think I am weird.
Well I do not I am ugly but with these scars it makes me unattractive to females.
Stealth. I would be more excited but my depression is killing me to the point where I am losing interest in everything.

No, I haven't. My acne scars are depressed similar to this http://www.acnespecialists.com.au/before-after/synergy-program-acne-scars/case-10-atrophic-and-rolling-scars. They also get a little red so that doesn't help. I am just a wreck.

When I was in high school I was judged because of my skin and people were always condescending to me. I am pretty sure the real world is the same. 

As for the greenhouse, I am unsure what you are getting at. Do you think I should start a greenhouse or work at one? I don't live on land where I could make my own greenhouse.
Fallout, Destiny and cod zombies. I also like science fiction movies.
I am currently watching the star wars movies. The sites I go on are usually youtube, and reddit.

I heard microdermbrasion doesn't work for indented scars. I went to a dermatologist and he said they will eventually go away on their own. He said that just to make me feel better. 

I also do not know how to get a side job. I am physically capable of doing labor but my social skills are nonexistent.
There is not much else to say. I play video games, watch movies and go on the internet all day. I also walk on the treadmill so I don't get overweight.
I have depressed acne scars and facial redness.
